第58章 老中医的治疗手段-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安慢悠悠地从针包里抽出一根针，拈在指尖转了转，针身隐约有一层淡蓝色光泽。

“你是不是平时会觉得有些行为不受控制？时不时做出一些奇怪的事情？

比如明知道有些话不该说还忍不住说，明知道有些钱不该拿还忍不住拿？明知道不能去的地方还是控制不住腿？”

他像在做正经问诊，语气耐心极了。

“这就是病了。”

“而且还不轻。”

“不过没关系。”顾承安笑了一下，很阳光，很温和，“我刚好会一手针灸，给你扎几针疏通疏通，保证针到病除。”

他把手里那根针举到黎志义面前晃了晃。

“对了，提前跟你说一声，这针是特殊处理过的，普通银针刺激穴位只是酸麻胀痛，这个不一样，它能让人的神经变得更敏感，放大好几倍。”

“打个比方吧，你平时手指被针扎一下就那么点疼，用了我这针之后，同样的刺激，在你的感知里就是有人拿钉子往骨头里钉。”

“你说神不神奇？我保证，他绝对能针到病除！”

黎志义拼了命地摇头，喉咙里发出含混的惨叫。

顾承安没理他。

右手持针，左手翻开黎志义被扎带捆住的手掌，大拇指精准按在他的虎口位置。

“第一针，合谷，开个胃。”

针落。

没有犹豫，快准稳地刺入穴位，针尖透过皮肤、穿过肌肉层，直抵骨膜。

黎志义的眼睛瞬间瞪到了生理极限。

整个人像是被电击了一样，身体猛然弹起，脖子上的青筋暴起，面部肌肉扭曲，胶带下发出的声音已经不像是人能发出来的了。

顾承安面不改色，手指稳稳捻住针尾，微调角度，让刺激效果最大化。

然后松手，拈起第二根针。

“第二针，涌泉，在脚底。”

他弯腰拽过黎志义的脚，也没嫌弃。

“这个穴位比较特殊，脚底神经末梢密集，你可能会稍微觉得有点——刺激。”

针扎下去的那一刻，黎志义的身体出现了明显的痉挛反应，五根脚趾剧烈蜷缩，整条腿不受控制地抽搐。鼻涕和眼泪一起涌出来。

顾承安的表情从头到尾都没变过。

第三针，内关，手腕内侧。

Gu Chengan slowly took out a needle from the needle bag and turned it around on his fingertips. The needle body had a faint light blue sheen.

"Do you usually feel that some of your behaviors are out of control? Do you do strange things from time to time?

For example, you know you shouldn’t say something but you still can’t help saying it, or you know you shouldn’t take some money but you still can’t help taking it?You know you can't go somewhere but still can't control your legs?"

He seemed to be conducting a serious consultation, and his tone was extremely patient.

"This is sickness."

"And it's not light."

"But it doesn't matter." Gu Chengan smiled, very sunny and gentle, "I happen to be good at acupuncture. I will give you a few needles to clear up the pain, and I will ensure that the acupuncture will cure the disease."

He raised the needle in his hand to Li Zhiyi and shook it.

"By the way, let me tell you in advance, this needle is specially treated. The acupuncture points stimulated by ordinary silver needles will only cause soreness, numbness, swelling and pain. This one is different. It can make people's nerves more sensitive and amplify them several times."

"For example, if your finger is pricked by a needle, it usually hurts a little bit. After using my needle, the same stimulation will appear to you as someone driving a nail into the bone."

"You said God is not miraculous? I guarantee that he can definitely cure diseases with needles!"

Li Zhiyi shook his head desperately and let out a muffled scream in his throat.

Gu Chengan ignored him.

Holding the needle in his right hand, he opened Li Zhiyi's palm bound by a tie with his left hand, and pressed his thumb precisely on his tiger's mouth.

"The first shot, Hegu, will whet your appetite."

The needle dropped.

Without hesitation, the needle tip penetrates the skin and muscle layer and reaches the periosteum quickly and accurately.

Li Zhiyi's eyes instantly reached their physical limits.

The whole person seemed to have been shocked by electricity. The body suddenly bounced up, the veins on the neck popped out, the facial muscles were distorted, and the sound coming from under the tape no longer seemed like a human being.

Gu Chengan's face remained unchanged, his fingers firmly twisted the tail of the needle, and fine-tuned the angle to maximize the stimulation effect.

Then let go and pick up the second needle.

"The second shot, gushing spring, is on the sole of the foot."

He bent down and pulled Li Zhiyi's feet, but he didn't mind it either.

"This acupuncture point is quite special. The nerve endings on the sole of the foot are densely packed. You may feel a little - irritated."

The moment the needle was inserted, Li Zhiyi's body had an obvious spasm reaction. His five toes curled up violently and his whole leg twitched uncontrollably.Snot and tears welled up together.

Gu Chengan's expression never changed from beginning to end.

The third needle is Neiguan, on the inside of the wrist.
